sprites.name: bar_frame

sprites.name: bar_frame_slim
sprites.notes: NEW: slim stamina/eitr bar frame 380x46: leather grip ends, icon recess centre (49,23) r 12 for the pool glyph; window = inset left 70, right 36, top 13, bottom 11 (height 22), transparent; rails tile with period 240

sprites.name: separator_v
sprites.notes: NEW: thin vertical diamond-stud separator between status entries, native size

sprites.name: bar_trough
sprites.notes: dark recessed trough, drawn in the bar window under everything

sprites.name: bar_fill
sprites.notes: opaque grey-shaded painted fill (grey = shading, tint per pool via Image.color); right border = bright front fading out (soft energy falloff), left 6 px soft start; centre tiles with period 144

sprites.name: bar_lag

sprites.name: bar_growth
sprites.notes: max-growth shimmer: faint diagonal sheen, low alpha, tint bar_growth; transient

sprites.name: bar_end_line
